composition_label: Interest-based recommendations -> Knowledge-base answers -> Semantic search -> Web research

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in this isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Version 1 object: schema_version, SYNTHETIC fixture_label, profile, products, faqs, web, settings. All keys required; unknown keys rejected.
shared_schema.profile: Weighted interest tags, excluded tags, excluded product IDs, question
shared_schema.sources: Products have id/title/description/tags; FAQs have id/question/answer/product_ids; supplied web snapshots have url/title/text/product_ids.
shared_schema.shared_stage_envelope: stage, status (ok or abstained), reason, query, product_ids, items, evidence
shared_schema.shared_evidence: id, kind, source_id, title, text, url, product_ids
shared_schema.validation: One validation layer validates strict input shapes, source references, finite numbers, URLs, every stage envelope, grounding, exclusions, citations and handoff scope. CLI file/JSON/validation failures return one status:error JSON object and exit 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: interests -> faq: validated ranked recommendation IDs constrain eligible FAQ records; question plus matched preference tags becomes the retrieval query.
faq -> semantic: validated FAQ output preserves product scope and appends the verbatim supported answer to the query; on abstention the prior query remains unchanged.
semantic -> web: validated search result IDs constrain offline snapshot retrieval; inherited enriched query ranks snapshots.
All stages retain upstream evidence in order; downstream product scope cannot expand. Sources referencing excluded products are never exposed.

behavior.interests: Normalized exact tag matching, positive weighted preference score, exclusions before ranking, deterministic source-ID tie breaks, grounded match explanations.
behavior.faq: Extractive TF-IDF retrieval with question-word overlap, threshold and product scope gating; one verbatim answer with citation or explicit abstention.
behavior.semantic: Deterministic TF-IDF cosine search index over eligible products. Optional run_pipeline(request, embedder=callable) accepts a batch of source strings followed by the enriched query; returns same-size, finite, nonzero, equal-dimension vector lists. Scores blend lexical and nonnegative embedding cosine equally. No callable is loaded by the CLI.
behavior.web: Caller-supplied snapshots only. Exact lowercase DNS hostname allowlist; HTTPS on default port, no credentials, fragments, controls or backslashes. No redirects or network fetching. Findings are verbatim excerpts with original URL citations and inherited provenance.
behavior.abstention: Empty or below-threshold results produce stage status abstained and a reason. A successfully executed pipeline retains top-level status ok even when one or more stages abstain.
behavior.determinism: Stable source-ID tie ordering, bounded inputs, no random sampling, no generated unsupported claims.

excluded: Learned synonym semantics without injected embeddings
Verification of snapshot authenticity or real-world truth

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status ok and all four ordered stages successful
